mentions.name: Cooper
mentions.description: A custom AI agent that runs entirely in the browser with sandboxed tool execution. The Rust core compiles to WASM and is augmented with JavaScript tools including OPFS file access (read, list, edit files), sandboxed Python execution via Pyodide, sandboxed DuckDB execution via DuckDB-WASM, chart drawing, and image display. It supports OpenAI Completions-compatible API providers, ships a native CLI for local experimentation, and the web version bundles wllama to serve local GGUF models with optional WebGPU support for fully local, sandboxed agent execution.
